title: walkthrough data-select strips the authored filmcard.sel from history sheets
goal: Stepping through a walkthrough silently clears the selected item in the capture history panel, so its row of actions vanishes and the step no longer illustrates what the words describe. This keeps a panel's own selection unless the step is actually selecting something there.
notes: Any wt step with data-select clears sel/selc from every .filmcard in the stage (walkthrough.js data-select handler), so the history pane loses its authored one-selected-card state (history.css says ship with ONE .filmcard.sel so the action row is visible) once a user steps a walkthrough. Affects every wt page with a hist sheet, e.g. composites, component-configure-wt. Fix idea: scope the deselect sweep to the panels the step actually selects in, or exclude .filmcard strips that carry data-radio.
acceptance: Stepping through a walkthrough that shows a history panel leaves that panel's selected item selected, with its row of actions still visible
Steps that do select something still clear the previous selection in the panel they act on
Verified in a browser on at least two walkthroughs that include a history panel
